newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: MOTOR RACING-VILLENEUVE HOLDS OFF IRVINE IN ARGENTINA.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-VILLENEUVE HOLDS OFF IRVINE IN ARGENTINA.

text.p: Villeneuve opened up a 10-point lead in the world drivers'
championship on Sunday when he beat off a robust challenge from
Briton Eddie Irvine to win the Argentine Grand Prix.
Villeneuve, in a Williams, finished just 0.9 of a second
clear of the Ferrari driver after a dramatic tussle over the

It was 21-year-old Schumacher's first points finish in

Villeneuve's victory was his sixth and put him level in the
record books with his late father Gilles.
